Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Medial knee pain for one week.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions. Healed non-ossifying fibroma at the distal femoral metaphysis.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. Moderate extrusion of the body without discrete tear by MRI criteria.
Medial compartment cartilage: Low-grade fissuring at the notch third of the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss with subchondral edema and cystic change at the medial patellar facet and median ridge. Full thickness fissuring of the lateral facet. Partial thickness cartilage loss with full-thickness fissuring at the central and lateral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt. No lateral translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
High-grade patellofemoral compartment chondrosis. Low-grade medial and lateral compartments chondrosis.

COMPARISON:Plain films [Date].

CLINICAL HISTORY:Twisting injury 4 weeks prior. Suspected transient lateral patellar dislocation.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence, multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The medial meniscus is intact.

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. The fibular collateral ligament is intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. The iliotibial band is intact. Popliteus tendon insertion is intact.

No femoral trochlear dysplasia. No patellofemoral subluxation. The TT-TG distance measures 20 mm, above the upper limit of normal. The patellar retinacula are intact. Once again seen are well-corticated osseous fragments at the tibial tuberosity in keeping with chronic sequelae of remote prior Osgood-Schlatter's disease. Minimal marrow edema and tiny cysts are noted in the fragments. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.

Full-thickness cartilage denuding patellar apex and along the lateral patellar facet. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage.

Trace knee joint fluid. Small Baker's cyst. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration. 

IMPRESSION:
1. Lateralization of the tibial tubercle, predisposing to patellofemoral maltracking/instability. No patellofemoral subluxation.
2. High-grade patellofemoral chondrosis suggesting evolving moderate patellofemoral osteoarthritis of the left knee.
3. Chronic sequelae of remote prior Osgood-Schlatter's disease, also shown previously.
4. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Lateral menisküs anterior -posterior hornu ve gövde kesiminde grade II dejenerasyon izlendi.Anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyona sekonder kalınlaşma ve sinyal artışı izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamende periligamentöz ödem izlendi ( grade I sprain ).Patella medial fasette kartilaj bütünlüğünde kayıp izlendi. Lateral fasette kartilajda incelme, subkondral kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Femur medial kondil postero-süperior kesim komşuluğunda ekstraartiküler yerleşimli 2,5x1,5 cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlendi.Diz eklemi kapsülü posteriorunda yırtık ve yırtık ile ilişkili 2x1,5cm boyutlu ganglion kisti izlendi.Tibia interkondiler eminenc anteriorunda anterior çapraz bağ yapışma yeri düzeyinde 1cm çaplı subkortikal kist izlendi.Peripatellar cilt altı yağ dokuda ödem izlendi.Tibia femoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında daralma , ekleme komşu kemik yüzlerde subkondral skleroz ödem ve dejeneratif kistler izlendi. Bu düzeyde femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlendi. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlandır.Femur lateral kondilde subkondral alanda 6x4mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan her üç kompartmanda santral -marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlendi. Sonuç: Gonartroz, medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon, maserasyon , volüm kaybı ve kompleks yırtıklar , lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon, medial kollateral ligamende grade I sprain , suprapatellar bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit,  ekstraartiküler ganglion kisti, tibia interkondiler eminencde subkortikal kist, prepatellar cilt altı ödem, diz eklem kapsülü posteriorunda yırtık ve yırtık ile ilişkili ganglion kisti, patella medial fasette grade III lateral fasette grade II kondromalazi.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain for 2 years. No known injury. No history of knee surgery.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture. Normal background marrow signal. No focal osseous lesion. Marginal osteophytosis at the patellofemoral compartment. Button osteophyte at the medial femoral condyle.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Diminutive medial meniscus with blunting of the free edge of the meniscal body. Displaced meniscal fragment to the posterior joint recess. Moderate meniscal extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse articular cartilage irregularity with low-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing medial femoral condyle.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade articular cartilage loss throughout the medial patellar facet with regions of full-thickness chondral fissuring at the median ridge. Full-thickness chondral fissuring at the medial and central trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): No tear.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): No tear.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Extensor Apparatus: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis. Retro-quadriceps fat pad edema. Normal patellar tendon.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt. No lateral patellar translation. No patella alta. Tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance is 14 mm, normal.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No disproportionate muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	Complex degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus with displaced meniscal fragment at the posterior joint recess.
2.	Moderate patellofemoral compartment and mild medial tibiofemoral compartment chondrosis. 
3.	Small multiloculated Baker's cyst.
4.	Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Deutliche Ausdünnung des Knorpels in der Belastungszone der lateralen Femurcondyle. Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Knochenödem. Mukoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskus am Übergang der Pars intermedia zum Hinterhorn; keine meniskale Rissbildung. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Knorpelglatze der lateralen Patellafacette mit assoziiertem subchondralem Knochenödem in der inferioren Patella (Serie 7/ Image 12). Oberflächliche Irregularitäten der medialen Patellafacette, hier kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Ausgdehnter Gelenkerguss mit verdickter Synovia.

MRI of left knee with -Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

Findings:
> The contour of anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments appearing within normal limit
> High signal intensity in medial and lateral meniscus without significant extending to the surface, probably due to myxoid degeneration
> Bony fragement in posterior knee joint, suspecious of loose body.
> Spur formation in left knee joint and patella with subchondral edema and cysts, indicating osteoarthritis.
> Full thickness cartilage loss of patella, suggestive of chondromalacia
> Large amount of joint effusion with suprapatellar bursitis 

Impression:
1. Osteoarthritis of left knee joint
2. Suspect intra-articular loose body in posterior knee joint
3. Myxoid degeneration of medial and lateral meniscus
4. Chondromalacia of patella cartilage
5. Large amount of joint effusion with suprapatellar bursitis 

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation and further evaluation.
